t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes chosen can be valuable for a few rounds and will award more points to mushrooms for a while, but after a few rounds can switch to being less valuable to pick that same gnome, so switching the choice for gnome can help the player get the maximum amount of points.

vb_textbox.text: The more mushrooms you get, the more points you will receive. Trial all of the gnomes and see how much they are worth, and try to consistently choose those at least twice, then the value will most likely change. Another way is to just go randomly and see if choosing the right or left side or the gnomes with the pointy versus flat hats yield more mushrooms. Good luck!
